value.rationale: The smallest finite host is a natural size-complexity invariant for an active finite-group power-semigroup embedding problem. The theorem resolves it sharply for all monogenic index-period types and classifies all equality hosts and two-element generators, exhibiting a quadratic host-size blowup and a coprimality phase transition between uniquely cyclic and noncyclic minimizers. These are quantitative structural results beyond known existence observations.
